content: Our main contributions are thus: (i) a single method for both style transfer and grammatical error correction, without using annotated data for either task, (ii) support for both tasks on multiple languages within the same model, (iii) a thorough quantitative and qualitative manual evaluation of the model on both tasks, and (iv) highlighting of the model's reliability aspects on both tasks. We used publicly available software and data; an online demo of our results is available, but concealed for anonymization purposes.
